recentItems.title: Britain's growing youth mental health crisis
recentItems.description:
To say that the rates of mental ill health among young people are rising fast is hardly a revelation. 

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

A common response is to blame a lack of resilience on a so-called 'snowflake' generation. 

But an official review has found insecure work prospects, social media and a general lack of hope are very real factors feeding the crisis. 

The author of the report said urgent action is needed to bring waiting lists for treatment down. 

He also acknowledged the younger generation really do have a tougher time than others.

recentItems.title: US plans first public military execution in nearly a century
recentItems.description:
A public execution - the first in the US in nearly a century. Live streamed with no bar as to who can watch. 

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

That was what the US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth announced will happen on December 3rd, when a former army officer, Nidal Hasan, is scheduled to go before a military firing squad, sentenced to death for shooting 13 army colleagues in 2009. 

The move has caused outrage both in the US and around the world. President Trump however has approved the decision. 

And a warning, there are distressing themes in this report.

recentItems.title: Trump sanctions ICC as Nobel Peace Prize goes to Navi Pillay
recentItems.description:
The long running feud between the Trump administration and the International Criminal Court reached a new peak today as the US slapped further sanctions on it. 

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

It coincided with the Nobel Committee's decision to award its peace prize to Navi Pillay who once served as one of the court's judges. Donald Trump has long coveted the award.

recentItems.title: Zack Polanski under pressure as leadership crisis deepens
recentItems.description:
It was Zack Polanski whose leadership was being questioned today after he fell short in the by-election to replace Keir Starmer.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

But he is also being accused of a failure of leadership for not turning up at the Green Party conference last week as it debated whether Zionism was Racism. 

This evening he was joined by Ed Davey, after a Lib Dem Treasury Spokesman resigned, and is understood to be asking colleagues to join him in a vote of no confidence. 

2026 has already been a year of political turmoil in this country, is there more still to come?

recentItems.title: What next for Zack Polanski as Greens LOSE Holborn & St Pancras by-election?
recentItems.description:
Zack Polanski and the Green Party are facing pressing questions after Andy Burnham’s Labour held Keir Starmer’s former seat in the Holborn and St Pancras by-election.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

The result is a setback for Polanski’s hopes of challenging Labour on the left of British politics. With calls for his resignation after he declined to vote on the Green Party’s ‘Zionism is Racism’ motion, is this just a blip for the Green Party leader or is his leadership really under threat?

In this episode of The Fourcast, Jackie Long spoke to Green Party’s deputy leader Rachel Millward, as well as the political correspondent from the New Statesman Megan Kenyon and pollster from More In Common UK, Luke Tryl.
